name: Australian Sandalwood Oil
shortDescription: Soft, creamy woody oil steam-distilled from Santalum spicatum heartwood.
description: Australian Sandalwood Oil is steam-distilled from the heartwood of Santalum spicatum. It offers a soft, dry, woody-balsamic aroma prized in fine perfumery and meditation blends, with excellent fixative properties.

name: Cardamom Oil
shortDescription: Warm, spicy-sweet oil steam-distilled from green cardamom seeds.
description: Cardamom Oil is steam-distilled from the seeds of Elettaria cardamomum. Its warm, spicy and sweet aroma adds lift to oriental and gourmand accords and is widely used in flavour and fine fragrance work.

name: Carrot Seed Oil
shortDescription: Earthy, root-like oil distilled from wild carrot seeds, valued in skincare.
description: Carrot Seed Oil is steam-distilled from the dried seeds of Daucus carota. Earthy and slightly sweet, it is a favourite in natural skincare formulations and grounding aromatherapy blends.

name: Chamomile Oil German (Blue)
shortDescription: Deep-blue, sweet-herbaceous oil rich in chamazulene for soothing blends.
description: German Blue Chamomile Oil is steam-distilled from Matricaria chamomilla flowers. Its striking deep-blue colour comes from chamazulene formed during distillation, making it a prized soothing oil for skincare.

spec.majorConstituents: chamazulene (2-18%), alpha-bisabolol, bisabolol oxide A & B, farnesene

name: Chamomile Oil German (Green)
shortDescription: Greenish chamomile distillate, soft and herbaceous, rich in bisabolol.
description: This greenish German Chamomile distillate is gentle and herbaceous, with a high bisabolol content. It is used in calming skincare and aromatherapy blends where a lighter colour is preferred.

name: Cinnamon Oil
shortDescription: Warm, sweet-spicy oil rich in cinnamaldehyde from cinnamon bark.
description: Cinnamon Oil delivers a warm, sweet and spicy aroma driven by cinnamaldehyde. Widely used in flavour, warming massage blends and festive fragrance accords.

name: Citronella Oil
shortDescription: Fresh, lemony grass oil, a natural staple for outdoor & cleaning blends.
description: Citronella Oil is steam-distilled from Cymbopogon winterianus grass. Fresh and lemony, it is a popular natural ingredient in candles, sprays and uplifting blends.

name: Clove Bud Oil
shortDescription: Spicy, warm oil rich in eugenol, distilled from clove buds.
description: Clove Bud Oil is steam-distilled from the dried flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum. Intensely warm and spicy, it is rich in eugenol and used across flavour, oral-care and warming aromatherapy blends.

name: Cypriol Oil
shortDescription: Smoky, woody-earthy oil from nagarmotha root, a perfumer's fixative.
description: Cypriol (Nagarmotha) Oil is distilled from the roots of Cyperus scariosus. Its smoky, woody and leathery profile makes it a sought-after fixative in oriental and woody perfumery.

name: Eucalyptus Oil
shortDescription: Fresh, camphoraceous oil rich in 1,8-cineole for clarity blends.
description: Eucalyptus Oil is steam-distilled from the leaves of Eucalyptus globulus. Its fresh, camphoraceous aroma rich in cineole makes it a staple of respiratory and invigorating blends.

name: Frankincense Oil
shortDescription: Resinous, woody-citrus oil distilled from Boswellia serrata resin.
description: Frankincense Oil is steam-distilled from the resin of Boswellia serrata. Warm, resinous and subtly citrusy, it is treasured in meditation, skincare and fine fragrance.

name: Indian Sandalwood Oil
shortDescription: The legendary Santalum album — soft, sweet, long-lasting woody oil.
description: Indian Sandalwood Oil is steam-distilled from the heartwood of Santalum album. Renowned worldwide for its soft, sweet, persistent woody aroma and exceptional fixative quality, it is the crown jewel of Indian aromatics.

name: Kapoor Kachri Oil
shortDescription: Warm, spicy-woody Himalayan root oil used in attars and haircare.
description: Kapoor Kachri Oil is distilled from the rhizomes of Hedychium spicatum. Warm, spicy and woody, it is a traditional ingredient in Indian attars, incense and herbal haircare.

name: Lavender Oil
shortDescription: Floral, sweet & herbaceous oil from Lavandula angustifolia flowers.
description: Lavender Oil extracted from Lavandula Angustifolia flowers via steam distillation. Floral, sweet, and herbaceous aroma. Soluble in alcohol. Shelf life: 2 years. The most versatile oil in aromatherapy and natural perfumery.

name: Lemon Oil
shortDescription: Bright, zesty cold-pressed oil from fresh lemon peel.
description: Lemon Oil is cold-pressed from the peel of Citrus limon. Bright, fresh and zesty, it is a cheerful top note for cleaning, flavour and uplifting aromatherapy blends.

name: Lemongrass Oil
shortDescription: Strong, lemony-herbaceous oil rich in citral from fresh grass.
description: Lemongrass Oil is steam-distilled from Cymbopogon flexuosus. Strong, lemony and herbaceous, it is rich in citral and widely used in soaps, candles and refreshing blends.

name: Morpankhi Oil
shortDescription: Green, coniferous oil distilled from oriental arborvitae foliage.
description: Morpankhi Oil is steam-distilled from the foliage of Thuja orientalis. Fresh, green and coniferous, it is used in traditional formulations and grounding green accords.

name: Palmarosa Oil
shortDescription: Sweet, rosy-floral grass oil rich in geraniol, loved in skincare.
description: Palmarosa Oil is steam-distilled from Cymbopogon martinii. Sweet and rosy-floral with high geraniol content, it is a gentle, skin-friendly oil widely used in natural cosmetics.

name: Patchouli Oil
shortDescription: Deep, earthy-woody oil that improves with age; a perfumer's base note.
description: Patchouli Oil is steam-distilled from the cured leaves of Pogostemon cablin. Deep, earthy and woody, it is a classic base note and fixative that matures beautifully over time.

name: Peppermint Oil (Mentha Arvensis)
shortDescription: Cooling, minty oil rich in menthol from Mentha arvensis.
description: Peppermint (Mentha arvensis) Oil is steam-distilled and rich in menthol, giving a sharp, cooling, minty aroma used in flavour, oral-care and invigorating blends.

name: Rosemary Oil
shortDescription: Fresh, herbaceous-camphoraceous oil popular in haircare blends.
description: Rosemary Oil is steam-distilled from Rosmarinus officinalis. Fresh, herbaceous and slightly camphoraceous, it is a favourite in haircare, scalp and clarifying blends.

name: Spikenard Oil
shortDescription: Rare, earthy-musky Himalayan root oil prized in meditation.
description: Spikenard Oil is steam-distilled from the roots of Nardostachys jatamansi. Earthy, musky and deeply grounding, this rare Himalayan oil has been revered for centuries in meditation and fine perfumery.

name: Sugandh Kokila Oil
shortDescription: Spicy-camphoraceous Himalayan berry oil used in attar bases.
description: Sugandh Kokila Oil is distilled from the berries of Cinnamomum glaucescens. Spicy, woody and camphoraceous, it is a traditional component of Indian attar and incense bases.

name: Sugandh Mantri Oil
shortDescription: Earthy-woody aromatic root oil treasured in traditional attars.
description: Sugandh Mantri Oil is distilled from the roots of Homalomena aromatica. Warm, earthy and woody, it is a prized traditional ingredient in attars and oriental accords.

name: Sweet Basil Oil
shortDescription: Fresh, sweet-herbaceous oil from basil leaves, lifting and clarifying.
description: Sweet Basil Oil is steam-distilled from Ocimum basilicum. Fresh, sweet and herbaceous, it brings a clarifying lift to aromatherapy and flavour blends.

name: Tagetes Oil
shortDescription: Fruity-green marigold oil with a distinctive sweet-herbaceous note.
description: Tagetes Oil is steam-distilled from Tagetes minuta (wild marigold). Fruity, green and sweet-herbaceous, it is used in niche perfumery and traditional preparations.

name: Tea Tree Oil
shortDescription: Fresh, medicinal oil rich in terpinen-4-ol, a skincare staple.
description: Tea Tree Oil is steam-distilled from Melaleuca alternifolia. Fresh and medicinal with high terpinen-4-ol content, it is one of the most popular oils in natural skin and scalp care.

name: Vetiver Oil
shortDescription: Deep, smoky-earthy root oil; a legendary perfumery base & fixative.
description: Vetiver Oil is steam-distilled from the roots of Chrysopogon zizanioides. Deep, smoky and earthy, it is one of the finest natural fixatives and a cornerstone of woody and chypre perfumery.

name: Chandan Attar
shortDescription: Classic sandalwood attar — soft, creamy and meditative.
description: Chandan Attar captures the soft, creamy warmth of sandalwood through traditional deg-bhapka distillation into a sandalwood oil base. Smooth, long-lasting and deeply calming, it is a timeless Indian classic.

name: Genda Attar
shortDescription: Bright marigold attar — green, fresh and festive.
description: Genda Attar distils the cheerful, green-floral character of marigold flowers into a smooth oil base. Bright and uplifting, it evokes Indian festivities and temple garlands.

name: Gulab Attar
shortDescription: Romantic rose attar distilled the traditional Kannauj way.
description: Gulab Attar captures the lush, honeyed depth of Indian roses through traditional deg-bhapka distillation into sandalwood oil. Rich, romantic and beautifully rounded, it is the heart of Indian attar tradition.

name: Hina Attar
shortDescription: Warm, complex herbal-woody attar blending many botanicals.
description: Hina Attar is a complex, warm blend of herbs, spices and woods distilled in the traditional manner. Deep, resinous and long-lasting, it is favoured for winter wear and oriental compositions.

name: Kesar Attar
shortDescription: Luxurious saffron attar — warm, sweet and golden.
description: Kesar Attar carries the warm, hay-like sweetness of saffron into a smooth oil base. Opulent and golden, it is treasured for special occasions and regal accords.

name: Kewda Attar
shortDescription: Exotic screw-pine attar — sweet, fruity and intensely floral.
description: Kewda Attar distils the heady, sweet-fruity bloom of the screw pine flower (Pandanus). Distinctive and intensely floral, it is a beloved note in Indian perfumery and cuisine.

name: Khus Attar
shortDescription: Cooling vetiver attar — earthy, green and refreshing.
description: Khus Attar captures the cool, earthy-green character of vetiver roots. Refreshing and grounding, it is a traditional Indian summer favourite distilled into a smooth oil base.

name: Mehandi Attar
shortDescription: Soft, sweet-herbaceous henna-blossom attar.
description: Mehandi Attar carries the soft, sweet-herbaceous warmth associated with henna flowers and traditional blends. Gentle and rounded, it layers beautifully with rose and sandalwood.

name: Mitti Attar
shortDescription: The scent of the first rain — baked-earth petrichor attar.
description: Mitti Attar bottles petrichor — the evocative aroma of the first monsoon rain on parched earth. Distilled from baked clay (khapra) into sandalwood oil, it is uniquely Indian and deeply nostalgic.

name: Mora Attar
shortDescription: Traditional musky-floral attar with a soft, powdery drydown.
description: Mora Attar is a traditional blended attar with a soft, musky-floral character and a powdery drydown. Warm and comforting, it wears close to the skin.

name: Motia / Belated Attar
shortDescription: Intoxicating Arabian jasmine (mogra) attar — sweet and narcotic.
description: Motia (Mogra) Attar captures the rich, sweet, narcotic bloom of Jasminum sambac. Intensely floral and sensual, it is one of the most prized white-floral attars of India.

spec.majorConstituents: benzyl acetate, linalool, indole, methyl anthranilate

name: Mukhallat Attar
shortDescription: Rich oriental blend of oudh, rose, saffron and spices.
description: Mukhallat Attar is a luxurious oriental blend marrying oudh, rose, saffron, musk and spices. Opulent and multifaceted, it embodies the art of Arabian-Indian perfume blending.

name: Oudh Attar
shortDescription: Deep, resinous agarwood attar — the king of fragrances.
description: Oudh Attar is distilled from precious agarwood (Aquilaria), yielding a deep, resinous, animalic-woody aroma of extraordinary longevity. Revered across Arabia and India, it is the king of fragrances.

name: Shamama Attar
shortDescription: Legendary multi-herb attar — warm, complex and long-lasting.
description: Shamama Attar is a legendary, labour-intensive blend of dozens of herbs, spices, roots and woods distilled together over weeks. Warm, complex and deeply tenacious, it is a masterpiece of traditional Indian perfumery.

name: Ruh Genda
shortDescription: Pure marigold ruh — intense, green-floral and rare.
description: Ruh Genda is the pure, base-free distillate of marigold flowers — a labour-intensive ruh with an intense green-floral character. Highly concentrated and rare, it is used sparingly by master perfumers.

name: Ruh Gulab
shortDescription: Pure Indian rose otto — the legendary base-free rose distillate.
description: Ruh Gulab is the pure rose otto of India — the base-free steam distillate of Rosa damascena petals. It takes thousands of roses to yield a few grams, producing an unrivalled, deeply honeyed rose of extraordinary finesse.

spec.majorConstituents: citronellol, geraniol, nerol, stearoptene, phenylethyl alcohol

name: Ruh Kewda
shortDescription: The rarest screw-pine ruh — sweet, fruity and opulent.
description: Ruh Kewda is the ultra-rare, base-free distillate of screw-pine (Pandanus) flowers. Sweet, fruity and intensely floral, it is among the most precious aromatics of India.

name: Ruh Khus
shortDescription: Pure vetiver ruh — deep, smoky-earthy and cooling.
description: Ruh Khus is the pure, base-free distillate of vetiver roots, often presented with its characteristic deep green hue. Smoky, earthy and cooling, it is a grounding masterpiece and superb natural fixative.

name: Ruh Motia
shortDescription: Pure mogra (jasmine sambac) ruh — narcotic white-floral luxury.
description: Ruh Motia is the pure, base-free distillate of mogra (Jasminum sambac) flowers. Rich, sweet and narcotic, this rare white-floral ruh is the pinnacle of Indian jasmine artistry.

spec.majorConstituents: benzyl acetate, linalool, indole, methyl anthranilate

name: Gulab Jal
shortDescription: Pure rose water — gentle, hydrating floral toner & culinary water.
description: Gulab Jal is 100% pure rose water, the aromatic distillate water of Rosa damascena petals. Soft and naturally hydrating, it is used as a facial toner, in cooking, and in religious and culinary traditions across India.

name: Kesar Water
shortDescription: Saffron-infused aromatic water — warm, luxurious and golden.
description: Kesar Water is a delicate saffron-infused aromatic water with a warm, sweet character. It is used in premium skincare, desserts, beverages and devotional preparations.

name: Kewda Jal
shortDescription: Screw-pine aromatic water — sweet, exotic flavouring & toner.
description: Kewda Jal is the pure aromatic water of screw-pine (Pandanus) flowers. Sweet and exotic, it is a classic Indian flavouring for sweets and biryanis, and a refreshing skin mist.

name: Khus Jal
shortDescription: Cooling vetiver water — earthy, refreshing summer hydrosol.
description: Khus Jal is the cooling aromatic water of vetiver roots. Earthy and refreshing, it is a traditional Indian summer drink flavour and a soothing skin mist.

name: Panch Pushpa Jal
shortDescription: Five-flower aromatic water — balanced, devotional floral blend.
description: Panch Pushpa Jal is a harmonious blend of five sacred flower waters. Balanced and gently floral, it is used in devotional rituals, ambient freshening and skincare.
